general_criterion: For normal integral projective T over C, dim(T)>=2, the positive cone generated by integral codimension-one Ottem-ample subvarieties equals the image of Amp(T) in N_(n-1)(T), and is open in the full numerical space iff that map is surjective.
independent_strengthening: Explicit elementary-transform vector bundles separate the two ruling-plane classes by second Chern degrees, independently of numerical Gysin descent.
source_scope: The OWR introduction uses smooth subvarieties of complex projective manifolds; its problem contextualizes higher codimension. The singular-ambient codimension-one example does not resolve that intended problem.
acceptance_limits: No smooth-ambient counterexample or general openness theorem established
No counterexample to a separately codimension-at-least-two restriction established
No novelty claim or certification of worldwide current problem status
Theorem-level geometric arguments are not certified by finite exact arithmetic tests
The general normal criterion allows all integral centers; smooth-only generation is proved here only for the specific quadric.
No external human peer review, journal acceptance, or formal proof-assistant certification is claimed.
included_optional_enhancements: Independent elementary-transform vector-bundle separation by second Chern degrees, already proved in the accepted audit
